skills.name: risk-ahead
skills.changes: a bounded latent delivery exposure into the smallest evidence-linked preventive specialist artifact
skills.trigger: a delivery approaches a commitment gate or hidden dependency risk compliance rework or stakeholder signals appear
outputs: specialist selection and evidence-linked preventive artifact

skills.name: shadow-dependency-map
skills.changes: workflow wait and ownership evidence into a map of hidden dependencies bottlenecks substitute paths and coordination actions
skills.trigger: a plan repeatedly waits or a change crosses approval expertise data environment operational or team boundaries
outputs: shadow dependency map and minimum coordination plan

skills.name: silent-risk-accumulator
skills.changes: exceptions test gaps assumptions drift and deferrals into an evidence-linked interaction map and minimum pressure-relief actions
skills.trigger: individually tolerable risks may combine into material delivery exposure
outputs: risk combination map and leverage-ranked pressure-relief actions

skills.name: compliance-preflight
skills.changes: requirements designs data flows policies and review history into early review points evidence needs design options and accountable consultations
skills.trigger: a change affects data identity permissions regions payments audit regulated workflows or customer commitments
outputs: compliance preflight packet and evidence preparation plan

skills.name: rework-early-warning
skills.changes: requirement decision implementation and test change evidence into a bounded rework warning and highest-leverage clarification
skills.trigger: requirements acceptance decisions assumptions dependencies implementation or tests change repeatedly without convergence
outputs: rework warning and bounded intervention options

skills.name: stakeholder-surprise-detector
skills.changes: change impact ownership history and commitments into a minimal evidence-linked stakeholder engagement plan
skills.trigger: a change may materially affect roles that have not been involved before the low-cost decision point
outputs: minimal stakeholder engagement plan and briefing material
